declaredAdvisories.reason: A Semantic Studio change can now exist without a chat thread, so threadUuid in the Studio workspace responses becomes nullable. These routes serve only Semantic Studio editing, which is behind the semantic-studio-editing feature flag; the flag is off by default on Cloud and on self-hosted, and the web app's Studio page is the only caller. During a rolling update an old Studio tab may not open a chat for a change created without one until refresh; nothing is written or lost.
